title: Исход 26 — Exodus 26
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Сделай ___ из десяти покрывал крученого льна.
cases.translation: Make the tabernacle of ten curtains of twined linen.
cases.explain: Скиния is the direct object of сделай (make) → accusative; a feminine -я noun takes -ю → скинию.

cases.sentence: Сделай скинию из десяти ___ крученого льна.
cases.translation: Make the tabernacle of ten curtains of twined linen.
cases.explain: The preposition из and the numeral десять both call for the genitive plural → покрывал.
The instrumental names what the curtains are decorated with (embroidered with cherubim) → херувимами.

cases.sentence: Сделай 50 золотых ___ и сцепи ими покрывало.
cases.translation: Make fifty gold clasps and couple the curtains with them.
cases.explain: A numeral of five or more (here 50) requires the genitive plural → крючков.

cases.sentence: Сделай для ___ прямые брусья из акации.
cases.translation: Make upright boards of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) takes the genitive → скинии.

cases.translation: …bring the ark of the covenant in there behind the veil.
cases.explain: The preposition за marking motion to behind something takes the accusative → завесу.

cases.sentence: Повесь её на золотых ___ четырёх позолоченных столбов.
cases.translation: Hang it on the gold hooks of four gilded pillars.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → крюках (prepositional plural).

cases.sentence: Поставь скинью по ___, показанному тебе на горе.
cases.translation: Set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition по meaning "according to" takes the dative → образцу.

reading.ru: Все покрывала пусть будут одинаковыми, 28 локтей в длину и 4 локтя в ширину.
reading.question: What were the dimensions of each linen curtain?
reading.explain: Each of the curtains was to be the same size, 28 cubits long and 4 cubits wide.

reading.ru: Сделай 11 покрывал из козьей шерсти, покров скиния.
reading.question: What material were the eleven curtains for the covering made from?
reading.explain: The eleven curtains that formed the covering were made of goats' hair.

reading.ru: Сделай 50 бронзовых крючков и вложи их в петли, чтобы соединить покров скинии в одно целое.
reading.question: What were the fifty bronze clasps used for?
options: To join the covering into one whole
To fasten the boards to the ground
reading.correct: To join the covering into one whole
reading.explain: The fifty bronze clasps were put into the loops to couple the covering together as one.

reading.ru: Сделай для скинии прямые брусья из акации, каждый брус должен быть 10 локтей в длину и 1,5 локтя в ширину, с двумя выступами, параллельными друг другу.
reading.question: What wood were the boards of the tabernacle to be made from?
reading.explain: The upright boards for the tabernacle were to be made of acacia wood.

reading.ru: Завеса будет отделять святое место от святого святых.
reading.question: What was the veil meant to separate?
options: The holy place from the most holy
reading.correct: The holy place from the most holy
reading.explain: The veil was to divide the holy place from the most holy place.

reading.ru: Для входа в шатер сделай завесу из голубой, пурпурной и алой пряжи и крученого льна, украшенную шитьем.
reading.question: What was made for the entrance to the tent?
options: An embroidered screen of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and twined linen
reading.correct: An embroidered screen of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and twined linen
reading.explain: The entrance screen was made of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and twined linen, decorated with embroidery.
